title: Vector Determinant in the ARE Framework: From Scalar to Vector-Valued
summary: The ARE (Action, Rectification, and Structure) method is presented as a framework for reorganizing the Leibniz expansion of the determinant through the action of the cyclic group C_n on S_n. This action partitions the permutations into orbital classes and naturally leads to a finite Fourier decomposition of the determinant structure. The central object of the work is the vector determinant, whose components are Fourier modes associated with orbital sums of Leibniz terms.
